prompt:
We are a business currently under the attack of a significant amount of fraudulent activities.

I would like to write them a friendly but stern letter to them requesting that they cease and desist from performing credit card fraud and account highjacking. They have cost us quite a bit of money so far.
response:
Dear Fraudsters,
We hope this letter finds you well. We are writing to request that you kindly cease and desist from performing credit card fraud and account hijacking on our platform. It's been quite costly for us, and we would appreciate your cooperation in stopping these activities. If you have any concerns or issues, please reach out to us so we can resolve them amicably. Sincerely, [Your Business]
